visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static extreme close-up of five decorated fake nails resting on a light-colored, porous stone slab with a rough texture. A bottle of black nail polish with a white cap is positioned in the foreground on a clean white surface. (2) A person's hands with shimmering manicured nails enter the frame. One hand holds a single black-painted fake nail mounted on a small stand, while the other hand uses a brush to apply a silver, sparkling, galaxy-like layer over the black base coat. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed close-up of a sheet filled with various colorful Halloween-themed stickers, including hearts, smiley faces, and ghosts. A pair of metal tweezers carefully peels off a small white ghost sticker with a simple face. (4) The tweezers carefully place two small white ghost stickers onto the shimmering black nail. The background remains the same textured stone surface, and the lighting is bright and direct, casting soft shadows that emphasize the nail's texture. (5) A clear nail polish brush is used to apply a top coat embedded with colorful iridescent sequins and fine glitter. The brush strokes are smooth and deliberate, adding a final glossy finish to the decorated ghost-themed nail art. (6) The completed nail art is showcased in the center of the frame against the textured stone. Animated Halloween graphics of a spider and orange text overlays appear to conclude the tutorial. The camera remains static throughout the shot.
